asks: Is the west front too much? Be truthful.
How much of this can you actually hold in your head?
Would you like a window with you in it?
description: A brass structure stands here the size of a wardrobe and the shape of a church seen from a long way off, and it's adding to itself, buttresses and tracery and small saints in small niches, without ever finishing.
emotes: {it} extrudes a spire, considers it, and folds it back in.
Something small and brass detaches from {it}, walks two steps, and rejoins it.
A whole face of {it} refolds into a different order of ornament, silently.
looks: It's producing more of itself, tastefully, and at speed.
You look at one square inch of it for about a year and a half.
Underneath all the detail it's exactly what it was, which is the strangest part.
name: a cathedral of folding brass
says: It's going very well, thank you for asking.
You're only seeing the first four or five layers.
This is what it does when you aren't looking. You're welcome.
